blackboard.strategy_router: strategy-registry.mjs decides HOW cajh trades, never whether. selectStrategy({asset,regime,timeframe}) ALWAYS returns a strategy; confidence is expressed as POSITION SIZE (validated 1.0x / relative 0.5x / uncovered 0.25x), so weak evidence shrinks exposure instead of blocking a trade. No PASS exists yet, so nothing sizes above 0.5x and expectedEdge reads negative - tests assert both, so a future edit claiming a positive edge without new sealed evidence FAILS the suite rather than quietly trading on it. Adding a PASS entry requires a genuine sealed verdict plus the D3 human gate.
